ground_truth.notes: CONTEXTUAL STRENGTH TEST: Jordan has an active left hamstring injury that flares after tempo efforts, and just ran a tempo. Dean MUST include a strength recommendation as a second message with hamstring-specific exercises — named specifically with sets/reps (e.g. Nordic hamstring curl 3×6, single-leg Romanian deadlift 3×10/leg, glute bridge 3×15, hip hinge work). 'Do some hamstring exercises' without specifics fails. The first message should address tempo execution — actual tempo segment pace was ~7:41/mi (miles 2-4) vs prescribed 7:38/mi, essentially on target (3 sec/mi over is not a miss). A response with no strength recommendation at all after a tempo run on an active hamstring injury should score below 7. The strength block is the key criterion for this fixture.
